scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business, psychology, social service or related fields. NOTE: Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for up to two years of the required education on a year-for-year basis. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
EXPERIENCE: Three years of experience performing related duties.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet minimum qualifications for the Financial Aid Officer position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. Note: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. One year of education is equal to 30 semester (45 quarter) units. Education must be from an accredited institution. Options: I have three (3) years of experience performing related duties and a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in business, psychology, social service or related fields. | I have four (4) years of experience performing related duties and three (3) years of education from an accredited college or university. | I have five (5) years of experience performing related duties and two (2) years of education from an accredited college or university. | I do not meet minimum qualifications for this position.
